questions.question: What is the capital of Maharashtra?
questions.funFact: Mumbai is the home of Bollywood, India's huge Hindi film industry.

questions.question: What is the capital of West Bengal?
questions.funFact: Kolkata is famous for its yellow taxis and the giant Howrah Bridge over the Hooghly river.

questions.question: What is the capital of Gujarat?
questions.funFact: Gandhinagar is named after Mahatma Gandhi, who was born in Gujarat.

questions.question: Panaji is the capital of Goa.
questions.funFact: Panaji sits on the Mandovi river, and Goa was ruled by the Portuguese for over 400 years.

questions.question: The capital of Bihar is ___.
questions.funFact: Patna is a very old city; long ago it was called Pataliputra and was the capital of great empires.

questions.question: Match each eastern state to its capital.
questions.funFact: Jharkhand and Chhattisgarh are fairly new states, both created in the year 2000.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT an eastern state of India?
questions.funFact: Gujarat is on India's western coast, on the opposite side of the country from West Bengal.

questions.question: What is the capital of Odisha?
questions.funFact: Bhubaneswar is called the 'Temple City of India' because it has hundreds of old stone temples.

questions.question: Mumbai is the capital of Maharashtra and lies on India's west coast.
questions.funFact: Mumbai is India's biggest city for business and is often called the country's financial capital.

questions.question: The smallest state of India by area, on the west coast, is ___.
questions.funFact: Goa is India's smallest state by area and is famous for its sunny beaches.

questions.question: What is the capital of Madhya Pradesh?
questions.funFact: Bhopal is known as the 'City of Lakes' because of the many beautiful lakes around it.

questions.question: Kolkata was once the capital of British India.
questions.funFact: Kolkata (then called Calcutta) was the capital of British India until 1911, when it moved to Delhi.
